scenes.title: The Definition of Favor
scenes.summary: Favor is a service to one in need, not in return for anything nor for the benefit of the one who renders it; it is great when the need is great, the service hard, the moment critical, or the giver the only one or the first, like the man in the Lyceum who gave the mat.

scenes.title: Showing and Removing a Favor
scenes.summary: The speaker can show that one side was in need and the other served it, or take the favor away by saying that the service was self-interested, accidental, compelled, a repayment, worthless, or less than was done for enemies.
